COMPANY NAME: DHI Group, Inc.
INDUSTRY: Tech Talent Recruitment / Human Resources Technology
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: DHI Group operates two specialized talent marketplaces: Dice, the largest US technology-focused talent marketplace, and ClearanceJobs, the leading platform for professionals with active U.S. security clearances.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Employers and recruiters seeking technology professionals (engineers, developers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts) and organizations requiring cleared talent (e.g., defense contractors, government agencies).
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise
KEY FEATURES:
- AI-powered matching tools and proprietary skills algorithm
- Database of nearly 10 million tech professional profiles
- Taxonomy of over 100,000 distinct technology skills for precise candidate identification
- Specialized marketplace for candidates with active U.S. security clearances
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: Purpose-built platforms for specific professional communities rather than a one-size-fits-all marketplace; deep specialization in tech and cleared talent; 35+ years of brand longevity and market leadership in niche segments.
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Professional
industry: Tech Talent Recruitment / Human Resources Technology
